expected_behavior.spm_dfn_agreement_low_crate: SPM and DFN should agree within ~1% at 0.5C
expected_behavior.thermal_at_3C: cell temperature should rise >5 degrees C above ambient (25 C) during 3C discharge
expected_behavior.electrolyte_at_3C: significant electrolyte concentration gradient (>100 mol/m3) develops across the cell by end of 3C discharge

output_format.capacities_spm: dict mapping C-rate string to discharge capacity in Ah
output_format.capacities_dfn: dict mapping C-rate string to discharge capacity in Ah
output_format.voltage_rmse: dict mapping C-rate string to SPM-vs-DFN terminal voltage RMSE in V (for C-rates 1.0 and 3.0)
output_format.max_temperature_rise_3C: peak cell temperature rise above ambient in degrees C during 3C DFN discharge
output_format.electrolyte_conc_range_3C: max minus min electrolyte concentration in mol/m3 at end of 3C DFN discharge
